cards.card_text: And for the holy thing he harmed, he makes restitution and adds a fifth of its value.
cards.verse_text: Regarding any holy thing he has harmed, he must make restitution by adding a fifth of its value to it and giving it to the priest, who will make atonement on his behalf with the ram as a guilt offering, and he will be forgiven.

cards.verse_text: He must make restitution in full, add a fifth of the value, and pay it to the owner on the day he acknowledges his guilt.

cards.card_text: If someone kills an animal, the LORD says he must make restitution, not be put to death.
cards.verse_text: Whoever kills an animal must make restitution—life for life.
cards.snippet: Whoever kills an animal must make restitution—life for life.

cards.card_text: Then the LORD sets two cases side by side: whoever kills an animal must make restitution, but whoever kills a man must be put to death.
cards.verse_text: Whoever kills an animal must make restitution, but whoever kills a man must be put to death.
cards.snippet: Whoever kills an animal must make restitution, but whoever kills a man must be put to death.

cards.card_text: After confessing, the guilty person must make full restitution.
cards.verse_text: He must make full restitution, add a fifth to its value, and give all this to the one he has wronged.

cards.verse_text: But if the man has no relative to whom restitution can be made for the wrong, the restitution belongs to the LORD and must be given to the priest along with the ram of atonement, by which the atonement is made for him.
